::: {.home-section}

I’m interested in how economic resources came to be distributed as they are today, and why that matters for how societies respond to climate change. My [research](research.qmd) looks at these questions over the long run and also explores how inequality interacts with taxation, politics, and institutions. My work on wealth and income includes research with the [World Inequality Lab](https://inequalitylab.world/en/) in Paris and the [Wealth Inequality Project](https://wealthinequalityproject.org/) in Rome.

For correspondence, write to [ignacio.flores@psemail.eu](mailto:ignacio.flores@psemail.eu).
